summary: Three monthly packages and a stack of a-la-carte builds — picked, priced, and committed-to on this screen. No agency retainer, no Squarespace tax, no per-platform seat fees.
problemStatement: Noco builds beautiful work that nobody online ever sees. The site, the GMB listing, the FB page, the IG — each one is a few months stale, and there's no clean way to turn a referral into a quote, or a finished job into a repeat customer. You don't need a 'digital transformation,' you need a package that runs the web side of the shop on a steady schedule, and the option to sell pieces directly if you want it.

approach.title: Pick a tier
approach.detail: Spark, Forge, or Foundry — each is a fixed monthly that runs your site, social, GMB, and content on a published cadence. No surprises, no 'depends on scope.'

approach.title: Add what you want
approach.detail: Brand kit refresh, drone shoot day, ad spend mgmt, email blasts to past customers, marketplace build — every a-la-carte item is a checkbox with hours, MLL price, and what an agency would charge.

approach.title: One admin panel
approach.detail: Everything runs out of the Slab admin you already log into. Content, leads, customers, orders — same login for you and your foreman.

approach.title: Marketplace if you want
approach.detail: Optional. Stock pieces (fire pits, table bases, brackets) and a custom-fab quote form. Orders print to the shop floor; deposits land in Stripe; pickup notice goes out automatic.

packagesIntro.headline: Packages built for a shop, not a SaaS startup
packagesIntro.lead: Each tier is a fixed monthly. Everything below is on the schedule, every month, with a published report. Cancel anytime.

packages.name: Spark
packages.bestFor: Single-owner shops who just need the lights kept on online.

features.label: 1 social channel posted weekly (FB or IG)
Monthly asset pull from your phone + edit

packages.name: Forge
packages.tagline: Run the marketing side of the shop.
packages.bestFor: Active shops with a foreman or apprentice helping out. The default for most welders.

features.label: Lead form on site → owner email + Slab CRM
Auto review prompt after each job

packages.name: Foundry
packages.bestFor: Shops with a small team, a marketing budget, and a real desire to sell pieces direct.

features.label: FB + IG + YouTube Shorts, daily posting cadence
Meta + GMB ad spend mgmt (flat fee, no % of spend)
Monthly strategy call + quarterly business review
Phone + text, 1h response during shop hours

alaCarte.headline: Add-ons (one-time builds, optional)
alaCarte.lead: Each item is a checkbox. Total updates in the cart. Hire one, hire all, hire none.

views.title: Monthly Packages
views.subtitle: Pick a tier. Each one runs the web + marketing on a published schedule. Compare side-by-side, see what's in and what's not.

scope.title: Spark · onboarding + month 1
scope.description: Setup, GMB connection, first social schedule, first asset pull. Billed monthly thereafter at $600.

scope.title: Forge · onboarding + month 1
scope.description: All Spark, plus FB+IG cadence, blog, lead form, review loop, quarterly shoot day. Billed monthly thereafter at $1,200.

scope.title: Foundry · onboarding + month 1
scope.description: All Forge, plus YouTube Shorts, monthly drone shoot, paid ads mgmt, marketplace ops, CRM campaigns. Billed monthly thereafter at $2,400.

views.title: Marketing · Lead Funnel
views.subtitle: What a Forge or Foundry month actually moves — ECharts funnel, source mix, and the 90-day campaign view your monthly report sits on top of.

scope.title: Source attribution wiring
scope.description: Tag every site session, GMB call, and form fill with its source (FB, IG, GMB, organic, referral).

scope.title: Ad spend management (Meta + GMB)
scope.description: Campaign setup, weekly tuning, creative rotation. Flat fee, no % of spend, no platform markup.

scope.title: Review request loop
scope.description: Auto-prompt past customers for GMB + site reviews after pickup. SMS optional.

scope.title: Brand kit refresh
scope.description: Vector logo set, color tokens, social templates, signage masters. Locked into Slab themes.

scope.title: Drone + photo shoot day
scope.description: Half-day at the shop or on a job site. RAW delivery, edited highlights to library.

scope.title: Email + SMS campaigns
scope.description: Past-customer list segmentation, monthly send, ROI tracking back in admin.

views.title: Client Management
views.subtitle: Every welding customer on one record — first contact through repeat jobs. D3 timeline of a real customer, plus the roster and follow-up queue.

scope.title: Customer profiles in Slab admin
scope.description: Contact, jobs done, last contact, lifetime spend, tags. One screen per customer.

scope.title: Job history per customer
scope.description: Every quote, job, invoice, asset tied to the customer record. Searchable.

scope.title: Follow-up queue + reminders
scope.description: Auto-tasks for 30/60/90-day post-job check-ins. Owner approves the send.

scope.title: Repeat-customer segmentation
scope.description: Tag customers by use (commercial / residential / decor / structural) for targeted campaigns.

scope.title: Customer-facing job portal
scope.description: Optional. Customer logs in, sees quote, job status, pickup time, gallery of the finished piece.

views.title: Marketplace · Optional
views.subtitle: Sell stock pieces and take custom-fab quotes through the site. Catalog grid, order admin, shop-floor ticket print — all in the Slab admin.

scope.title: Catalog + product schema
scope.description: Stock + configurable + custom-fab product types. Each SKU is a real product page with assets from the library.

scope.title: Stripe checkout + deposits
scope.description: Full payment on stock, 30% deposit on custom-fab. Tax + shipping per zone.

scope.title: Custom-fab quote intake
scope.description: Quote form, file upload, owner-priced response, deposit link emailed back to customer.

scope.title: Order admin (open / in-fab / ready / fulfilled)
scope.description: Kanban-style lanes in the Slab admin. Owner + foreman drag orders between lanes.

scope.title: Shop-floor ticket print
scope.description: One-click print of the work order to the shop printer. Specs, SKU, customer, due date.

scope.title: Pickup + delivery notice
scope.description: Auto SMS + email when an order moves to ready. Includes shop hours + map.

funnel.note: ≥30s on page or scroll past hero

depositPolicy.quote: 30% deposit on quote acceptance, balance before pickup
